outcome: diagnostic accuracy for placenta previa localization and adherence
finding: MRI showed higher diagnostic accuracy (90.91%) for adherent placenta compared to USG (86.21%), although USG remains the most commonly used and sensitive imaging modality for diagnosing placenta accreta and previa.
gest_age: Delivery occurred between 36-37 weeks in 60% of cases, with 72% of deliveries being preterm.
